tasks.OvertimeHourRateCalculation: Calculate the overtime hourly rate as 1.2 times the regular hourly rate of $10 per hour.
tasks.OvertimePayCalculation: Calculate the overtime pay for the additional hours worked beyond 40, which is based on the calculated overtime hourly rate.
tasks.RegularPayCalculation: Calculate the regular pay based on the first 40 hours at $10 per hour.
tasks.TotalEarningsCalculation: Sum up the total earnings by adding the regular pay and the overtime pay.
